說明: 可愛待辦清單衝前十：統籌 10-19 決定指南站 Threads 名額每兩天撥 1 則給可愛待辦清單，試到 11-02（共 7 則）。12 部門提供題材與文案，05 實作排程。主貼文不放連結；第一則回覆放 App Store 直連（Play 上線就加 Play 直連）＋ct。功能只寫商店文案已有的（data/mochi_full.json：勾選清單、提醒、主畫面小工具、Apple Watch、101 款主題、表情符號組），不寫價格、免費、進階版字樣。評估：ct 點擊／下載＋reports/mochi_top10/ 對應詞名次，沒效就還原。 2026-10-20 04 部門：照 ops/company/mochi_no1_strategy.md C.1「Threads 每天 3 則裡固定 1 則給它」，10-22 起改成每天 1 則（10-21 空著，留給 10-20 那則補發），到 11-02 共 13 則；仍是同一格、同一上限，不多發。 2026-10-21 05 部門（業主 10-21「每天都狂推 把它變每天的既定行程」）：10-21 補 1 則（th_mochi_en_06；10-20 那則已準時發出，補發日用不到）；11-02 之後不結束，照 daily_after_end.cts 的順序每天 1 則（只放不分季節的文案，萬聖節、秋季、年底、考試期間那 5 則不放），同一格、同一上限；要換新文案就在 posts 追加有日期的新則，循環自動往後延。 2026-10-21 05 部門（統籌受眾分眾，00_GrowthEngine ops/company/audience/mochi.md）：10-22 起每天這 1 則依序輪流給考生（exam）／主揪（host）／新年重開機（reset），11-02 後 daily_after_end 也照同一順序循環；主題標籤依族群（考生 공부／Study、主揪 Holidays、重開機 Productivity）；仍是同一格、同一上限，不多發。原本 10-22 以後的一般款文案移到 unscheduled（沒有程式讀它，要再用就給日期放回 posts）。追蹤碼仍用 th_mochi_<語言>_<編號>（循環會重複用同一則，帶月日的 ln_mochi_ 格式要等統一改追蹤碼時一起改）。感恩節兩則 11-26 後要換聖誕主揪版、考生兩則 11-19 後要換考後版。

posts.pain: 長長的待辦讓人不想開始
posts.text:
My to-do list used to stress me out more than the tasks did.

So I switched to a tiny cute checklist: tap the little circle, watch it check off, feel weirdly calm.

Turns out I just needed my list to not look like a spreadsheet.
posts.reply:
It's called Mochi: Cute Checklist 🍡 (iPhone + Apple Watch)
{link}

posts.pain: 早上不知道從哪件事開始
posts.text:
Tiny night routine that fixed my mornings:

Before bed I write tomorrow's three things in a cute checklist and set a reminder for the first one.

Wake up, glance at the Home Screen widget, and I already know where to start. No more staring at my phone wondering what I was supposed to do.

posts.pain: 시험 전 할 일이 너무 많아서 막막함
posts.text:
시험 전 투두리스트는 작게 쪼개는 게 답이더라 ✏️

'영어 공부' 말고 '단어 30개', '기출 1회'처럼 나눠서 적고, 하나 끝낼 때마다 톡 체크.
귀여운 테마로 바꿔두니까 앱 여는 게 덜 부담스러움.

오늘도 체크 하나씩.

posts.pain: 第一次主辦感恩節，事情一大堆
posts.text:
First time hosting Thanksgiving and my brain is just a pile of tiny jobs.

So it all went into a cute checklist: menu, groceries, who's bringing what, clean the guest room. A reminder for the turkey, and I check things off on my Apple Watch while I cook.

Still stressed. But it's organized stress now 🦃

posts.pain: 每年等到一月才想重新開始，然後又放棄
posts.text:
Starting my reset now instead of waiting for January.

One small checklist for the rest of the year: drink water, a short walk, read before bed, tidy one drawer. It sits on my Home Screen widget so I actually see it.

Tap the little circle, feel a tiny bit of progress. That's the whole plan.

posts.pain: ENEM chegando e não sabe por onde começar
posts.text:
ENEM chegando e meu cronograma de estudos era um caos.

Agora cada matéria virou uma lista fofa no iPhone: redação, matemática, revisão de natureza. Coloco um lembrete pra cada bloco de estudo e vou tocando no circulinho quando termino.

Ver o progresso assim deixa tudo menos assustador ✏️

Halloween prep, but make it cute 🎃

☐ finish the costume
☐ buy candy (and hide some)
☐ carve the pumpkin
☐ party playlist

My to-do list has a theme I actually like looking at, so I keep opening it. That's the whole trick.

Fall reset checklist I'm actually finishing this year 🍂

☐ swap closet
☐ clean out the fridge
☐ back up phone photos
☐ book that appointment

Keeping it in a cute checklist app with reminders so it doesn't live in my head anymore.

posts.pain: 考試快到了，計畫只有「全部都要讀」
posts.text:
Midterms now, finals next, and "study everything" was my whole plan.

Now each class gets its own cute checklist: chapter notes, practice problems, flashcards, review session. A reminder for every study block, and I tap the little circle when it's done.

Watching the list shrink is weirdly motivating 📚

Holiday travel packing used to mean remembering the charger at the airport.

Now there's a cute packing checklist on my phone: chargers, meds, gifts, the good socks. A reminder the night before, a quick glance at my Apple Watch at the door.

Nothing forgotten this trip. So far 🧳

posts.pain: 總是等「下週一」才要重新開始
posts.text:
Not waiting for Monday, or January, to restart anymore.

One cute list on my Home Screen: move a little, save a little, sleep earlier, call mom. Nothing fancy, just small circles I can tap every day.

Tiny progress still counts 🍡

시험 기간 체크리스트 이렇게 쓰는 중 📚

과목별로 리스트 나누고, 끝낸 건 톡 눌러서 체크. 테마도 바꿀 수 있어서 공부 다이어리 꾸미는 느낌.

알림 설정해두면 과제 마감도 안 놓침.

posts.pain: 主辦朋友聚餐，菜單和採買很亂
posts.text:
Friendsgiving at my place this year, so naturally I made lists.

A menu list and a grocery list, both cute enough that I don't dread opening them. The grocery list goes on my Apple Watch at the store, and a reminder makes sure the pie gets ordered on time.

Hosting feels a lot less like a deadline now 🥧

posts.pain: 年底前想整理生活、事情很多
posts.text:
離年底剩不到兩個月，我把想完成的事全寫成待辦事項 🍂

☐ 整理衣櫃
☐ 手機照片備份
☐ 預約健康檢查
☐ 把一直拖的那本書看完

用表情符號分類、設好提醒，放在桌面小工具上，每天看一眼就不會忘。

unscheduled.pain: 투두리스트 앱이 너무 딱딱해서 안 쓰게 됨
unscheduled.text:
투두리스트 앱 깔아놓고 일주일 만에 안 여는 사람 나만 아니지…

귀여우면 계속 열게 되더라. 동그라미 톡 눌러서 완료하는 맛에 오늘 할 일 다 끝냄.

홈 화면 위젯으로 띄워두니까 까먹지도 않음.

unscheduled.pain: 早上不知道先做什麼、事情一多就亂
unscheduled.text:
每天早上只做一件事：把今天要完成的三件事寫進可愛的待辦清單 ✍️

提醒時間一到，手錶輕輕震一下；做完就點一下打勾，那個小小的完成感真的會上癮。

事情沒有變少，但心變得比較安定。

unscheduled.pain: 待辦事項散在便利貼、備忘錄、LINE 自己傳自己
unscheduled.text:
待辦事項寫在便利貼、備忘錄、LINE 傳給自己……最後全部忘光 😇

後來改用一個很可愛的待辦清單，打勾的時候有種小小的療癒感，桌面小工具一打開手機就看得到。

原來我缺的不是自律，是想打開它的理由。

unscheduled.pain: 雜事、購物、例行事項一堆 App 分開記
unscheduled.text:
Groceries in one app, chores in another, school stuff on a sticky note.

I put everything into one cute to-do list with a Home Screen widget and suddenly I actually see my day.

Small thing, big difference.

unscheduled.pain: やることを頭の中だけで覚えていて疲れる
unscheduled.text:
やることリスト、頭の中に置いておくのをやめた🍡

思いついたらすぐ書いて、時間になったら通知。終わったらポチッとチェック。
ホーム画面のウィジェットで今日の分がいつでも見えるから、もう「何するんだっけ」ってならない。

頭が軽くなるって、こういうことか。

ToDoリスト、どのアプリも三日坊主だった私。

かわいいアプリにしたら、毎朝ひらくのが楽しみになった🍡
チェックをタップするたびに小さな達成感。ホーム画面のウィジェットで今日のやることがすぐ見える。

続く理由って、意外とこういうこと。

unscheduled.pain: 手機一拿起來就分心，忘了要做什麼
unscheduled.text:
Checking my to-do list on my phone = 20 minutes of scrolling.

Every single time.

Now the list is on my Apple Watch. Glance, tap the circle, done. Phone stays in my bag.

Tiny change, way more focus.
